snapshotSubject: Identify scanned ore deposits with compact labels
reviewStatus: 1.0.7 English snapshot synchronized from the exact committed game source after source/catalog/token review and automated coverage validation. This refresh does not renew the English freeze or certify final release screen fit or Steam rollout.
notes: Packs overlay display/prose fields only. Leave IDs, save names, recipe Name/DisplaySource, category Key, glyph English, armor set Name and piece Set, and gameplay stats unchanged. Inherited recipe names and hidden debug recipes have no required DisplayName task. Prefab DisplayName inherits a translated Name where English values match. Container gump titles use UILocalization container.* keys. Vanilla pack-item Name/Description remains in LoadedContent item_*.json; export-pack-item-prose.py fills the sol.* InventoryItemData snapshot. Unique equipment-effect prose uses RuntimeContentLocalization effect.* fields. PREVIEW, INPUT, PROMPT, and decorative MAGNETIC HANDLE art labels are deferred until after the community localization launch. Conditional item descriptions translate DescriptionVariants[].Text matched by ItemID and variant ID; keep Priority, MinLanguage, and RequiredKnowledgeFlags unchanged. Help image markers and their content keys must be preserved on standalone lines.
